answers.transcript: Once upon a time, two friends went on a journey. They had to go through a forest on the way. As they saw the wood they saw a bear approaching to them. They both became very frightened. Suddenly, one of them climbed up a tree to be safe from the bear He didn't think about his another friend. Finding no other alternative, the other friend lay down on his face without breathing. Soon the bear came up and put down its head and smelt him. As he was lying down without breathing , the bear took him to be dead and went away. Seeing the bear went away , the friend who climbed the tree , came down from the tree. He asked his friend, "What did the bear whisper into your ears ?" The other friend told him, "The bear gave me a good piece of advice." The selfish friend asked , "What was that ?" The other friend told the selfish friend , "Never trust a friend who lives you alone in a danger."
answers.student_title: A friend in need is a friend indeed

answers.transcript: The annual prize-giving of our school was held on 28th January, 2026 . It was held on our school compound field. We decorated our school very beautifull. We decorated with flowers, paper craftings, etc. We also did some wall-paintings. The prizes were distributed placed beautifully on a table behind the chairs of the guests, The function began started just at 2:30 pm with the recitation of the holy quran. It was recited by student of class 8. Then our Headmaster read out the annual report of our school. Then The main guest was Distinguished professor Dr. Muhammad Kaikobad. He gave a short speech. He praised our school very much for our brilliant SSC and HSC result. He told that our school is very beautiful , its students are very well-mannered . After the speech, the main function started. One of our Senior teachers told the name of each recipient and the students took their prizes from the main guest and shook him by their hands. After the prize giving that , we staged a short drama to entertain our guests and audience. It was highly appreciated by the audience. Our head master thanked the main guest for attending the ceremony. Then a concluding song was sung by a student of class 9. After that the ceremony came to an end, We all liked our annual prize-giving ceremony. I will never forget that day.
answers.student_title: Annual Prize-Giving Day of My School

Sheila : That's impressive. You must be very happy with your result .
